name: AVIR Social Auto Poster Ultimate
author: Avir Media

sections.description:
AVIR Social Auto Poster Ultimate is the complete solution for automatically sharing your WordPress content to Facebook and Instagram. This powerful plugin helps bloggers, content creators, and businesses maximize their social media reach without the hassle of manual posting.

In today’s digital landscape, maintaining an active social media presence is crucial for driving traffic and engagement. However, manually sharing each post to Facebook and Instagram is time-consuming and often leads to inconsistent posting schedules. AVIR Social Auto Poster Ultimate solves this problem by seamlessly connecting your WordPress site to your social media accounts, ensuring your content reaches your audience at the right time, every time.

Unlike other social media plugins that require paid subscriptions for basic features, AVIR Social Auto Poster Ultimate provides all essential functionality completely free. Our plugin is designed with user experience in mind, offering an intuitive interface that makes social media automation accessible to everyone, regardless of technical expertise.

KEY FEATURES

Facebook Integration:

  • Auto-post to Facebook Pages with customizable content
  • Include featured images with your posts
  • Add custom hashtags to increase visibility
  • Choose between link posts or image posts
  • Preview posts before publishing
  • Track posting status with Facebook status indicators

Instagram Integration:

  • Share posts directly to Instagram Business accounts
  • Customize Instagram captions separately from Facebook posts
  • Add up to 30 Instagram-specific hashtags
  • Required featured image handling for Instagram compliance
  • Instagram post status tracking

Content Customization:

  • Create platform-specific excerpts for Facebook and Instagram
  • Set character limits for optimal social media formatting
  • Choose hashtag placement (before title or after excerpt)
  • Include or exclude URLs in your posts
  • Strip header tags from excerpts for cleaner posts
  • Add custom “Read More” text and link prefixes

User Interface:

  • Intuitive meta box for post-level control
  • Preview posts before publishing
  • One-click regeneration of social media excerpts
  • Character count indicators with limit warnings
  • Post status indicators in admin columns
  • Filter posts by social media publishing status

Advanced Features:

  • API connection testing tool
  • Detailed debug information
  • Customizable settings for each platform
  • Post to multiple platforms with different content
  • Mark posts as published/unpublished manually

DESIGNED FOR

  • Content Creators looking to expand their reach across multiple platforms
  • Bloggers who want to save time on social media management
  • Small Businesses aiming to maintain consistent social media presence
  • Marketing Teams seeking to streamline their content distribution workflow
  • News Sites that need to quickly share breaking stories to social media
  • Online Stores wanting to promote new products automatically

Why Choose AVIR Social Auto Poster Ultimate?

AVIR Social Auto Poster Ultimate stands out from other social media plugins by offering a comprehensive solution without hidden costs or premium features locked behind paywalls. Our plugin is designed to be both powerful and user-friendly, providing everything you need to automate your social media strategy effectively.

With regular updates and dedicated support, we ensure that AVIR Social Auto Poster Ultimate remains compatible with the latest versions of WordPress and social media APIs. Our commitment to quality and user satisfaction makes this plugin the preferred choice for thousands of WordPress users worldwide.

EXTERNAL SERVICES

This plugin connects to the following external services:

Facebook Graph API

  • Purpose: To publish posts from your WordPress site to your Facebook Page
  • Data transmitted: Post content, featured images, custom excerpts, hashtags, and API credentials (Business ID, Page ID, System User Token)
  • When data is sent: When publishing or updating posts (if auto-posting is enabled) or when manually triggering a post from the WordPress dashboard
  • Terms of Service: https://www.facebook.com/terms.php
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
  • Developer Terms: https://developers.facebook.com/terms/

Instagram Graph API

  • Purpose: To publish posts from your WordPress site to your connected Instagram Business account
  • Data transmitted: Post content, featured images (required), custom captions, hashtags, and API credentials
  • When data is sent: When publishing or updating posts (if Instagram posting is enabled) or when manually triggering a post from the WordPress dashboard
  • Terms of Service: https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870
  • Privacy Policy: https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy/
  • Developer Terms: https://developers.facebook.com/terms/

Note: Both APIs are provided by Meta Platforms, Inc. and require you to create and configure a Facebook Business account with appropriate permissions.
sections.installation:
Installing plugin file

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/avir-social-auto-poster-ultimate directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > AVIR Social Auto Poster Ultimate to configure your Facebook and Instagram credentials.
  4. Set your preferred posting options in the plugin settings.
  5. Start sharing your content to social media!

Facebook API Setup Guide (2025 Edition)

Note: Facebook regularly updates their interface. While we strive to keep these instructions current, the exact locations of settings may change. The core concepts and required credentials remain the same.

To use this plugin, you’ll need to set up a Facebook Business account and create API credentials. Follow these steps to get your Business ID, Page ID, and System User Token.

Step 1: Create a Facebook Business Account

  1. Go to Facebook Business Suite or search for “Facebook Business Suite” in your browser
  2. If you don’t have a Business account, you’ll be prompted to create one
  3. Follow the on-screen instructions to set up your Business account
  4. Make sure your Facebook Page is added to your Business account

Step 2: Find Your Business ID

  1. In your Business Suite, look for “Business Settings” or “Business Information”
  2. Your Business ID is typically displayed in the business details section
  3. It’s a numeric ID (e.g., 1234567890123456)
  4. Copy this ID and paste it in the “Business ID” field in the plugin settings

Tip: If you can’t find your Business ID, try looking in the URL when you’re in Business Settings. It often appears as “business_id=1234567890123456” or similar.

Step 3: Find Your Page ID

  1. In Business Settings, navigate to the Pages section
  2. Select your Facebook Page from the list
  3. Your Page ID should be visible in the page details
  4. Copy this ID and paste it in the “Page ID” field in the plugin settings

Alternative method: Visit your Facebook Page and look at the URL. Your Page ID is often visible in the URL or in the “About” section of your page.

Step 4: Create a System User

  1. In Business Settings, look for “Users” or “System Users” section
  2. Create a new System User (look for “Add” or “Create” button)
  3. Give it a name (e.g., “WordPress Auto Poster”) and select appropriate access level
  4. Complete the user creation process

Step 5: Assign Assets and Permissions to System User

  1. After creating the System User, you’ll need to assign assets (your Facebook Page)
  2. Look for options to add or assign assets to the System User
  3. Select your Facebook Page
  4. Assign the following critical permissions:
    • pages_read_engagement – To read page content
    • pages_manage_posts – To create posts
    • business_management – For business account access
    • pages_manage_metadata – For managing page content
    • instagram_basic – For basic Instagram access (if using Instagram)
    • instagram_content_publish – For posting to Instagram (if using Instagram)
  5. Save your changes

Important: Facebook may rename these permissions or add new required ones. If you encounter permission errors, check the error message for specific permission names.

Step 6: Generate System User Token

  1. In the System Users section, find your newly created user
  2. Look for an option to generate or create a token
  3. Select your Facebook Page when prompted
  4. Ensure all the required permissions are selected (see list in Step 5)
  5. Set the token to never expire if possible (recommended)
  6. Generate the token
  7. Copy the generated System User Token and paste it in the “System User Token” field in the plugin settings

Critical: This token will only be shown once. Make sure to copy it before closing the window. If you lose it, you’ll need to generate a new one.

Step 7: Test Your Connection

  1. After entering all three credentials, click “Save Settings”
  2. Then click the “Test API Connection” button to verify your credentials are working
  3. If successful, you’ll see your Facebook Page information and permissions
  4. If you encounter an error, check the error message for specific issues

Instagram Setup (Optional)

  1. To enable Instagram posting, your Instagram account must be:

    • A Business or Creator account (not a personal account)
    • Connected to your Facebook Page

  2. To convert to a Business account:

    • Open Instagram app
    • Go to your profile
    • Access the settings menu
    • Look for “Account” or “Account Type”
    • Switch to a Professional account (Business)

  3. To connect Instagram to your Facebook Page:

    • In your Instagram professional account settings
    • Look for Facebook or Page connection options
    • Follow the prompts to connect to your Facebook Page

  4. Once connected, enable Instagram posting in the plugin settings

Common Issues & Troubleshooting

  • Invalid token error: Your System User Token may have expired or doesn’t have the required permissions. Generate a new token with all necessary permissions.
  • No page access error: Make sure your System User has been assigned to your Facebook Page with the correct permissions.
  • No Instagram Business Account error: Ensure your Instagram account is a Business account and properly connected to your Facebook Page.
  • API version error: Facebook regularly updates their API. This plugin is designed to work with the latest version, but if you see API version errors, check for plugin updates.
  • Permission denied error: Facebook may have added new required permissions. Check the error message for specific permission names and add them to your System User.

Need More Help?

If you’re still having trouble setting up your Facebook API credentials:

  • Check our support forum for similar issues and solutions
  • Visit Facebook Developer Documentation for the latest API information
  • Search for “How to create a Facebook System User Token 2025” for up-to-date tutorials
sections.faq:
Is this plugin really free? Are there any hidden costs?

Yes, AVIR Social Auto Poster Ultimate is completely free with no hidden costs or premium versions. All features are included in the free version.

Why isn’t my post appearing on Facebook?

Make sure your Facebook Page is published and the system user has the correct permissions. Also check that your post isn’t violating Facebook’s content policies. You can use the built-in connection testing tool to verify your API credentials.

Can I customize the message that gets posted to each platform?

Absolutely! Each post has a meta box where you can customize the excerpt, add hashtags, and choose whether to include the featured image. You can create different content for Facebook and Instagram.

Does this plugin support scheduling posts?

The plugin automatically posts to social media when you publish a WordPress post. For advanced scheduling, you can use WordPress’s built-in scheduling feature to determine when your post (and consequently, your social media update) will be published.

Can I post to multiple Facebook Pages?

Currently, the plugin supports posting to one Facebook Page. For multiple Pages, you would need to set up separate WordPress installations or use a multisite network.

Is Instagram posting supported?

Yes! You can post to Instagram Business accounts that are connected to your Facebook Page. The plugin handles the required image formatting and caption customization for Instagram.

How do I get help if I have problems?

Visit our support forum for assistance. We typically respond within 24-48 hours.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No, AVIR Social Auto Poster Ultimate is designed to be lightweight and efficient. The social media posting happens in the background and doesn’t affect your website’s loading speed.

Is this plugin compatible with Gutenberg?

Yes, the plugin works with both Gutenberg and Classic Editor.

Can I use this plugin with custom post types?

By default, the plugin works with standard posts and pages. You can extend support for custom post types using the ‘avir_fbp_post_types’ filter.
